purpose: Compare current authored FIX gates against retained LOW/MID/HIGH reversible profiles after the first human H2A playtest. Add stat-drift, event-frequency, housing, low-stat risk, and faction-chain telemetry. Do not freeze a profile automatically.

profiles.note: True current control arm. Do not substitute the old Phase 1.1 ORIGINAL_REFERENCE profile.

whyArchetypeAllocation: The current H2A baseline diagnostics and manual play are closer to player-like concentrated allocations than the old Phase 1.1 BALANCED_RANDOM_FILL threshold experiment. This run is a current H2A calibration, not a replacement for the retained historical experiment.
requiredCoreMetrics: ending-age bucket counts, share of all runs, and share of completed runs
ending coverage and ending ID distribution
ending counts by route family and faction
mean FIX at commitment and ending
final material distribution and material guardrails
generic fallback and lore fallback by age band

drift: mean delta from post-setup starting visible stat at each snapshot age
mean positive authored delta per 1000 run-years by stat
mean negative authored delta per 1000 run-years by stat
share of runs whose final stat is lower/equal/higher than post-setup start
statTelemetry.interpretation: Telemetry only. Do not add visible-stat clamps or pressure rules in this task.

report: mean count among runs where event appears
housing: aggregate visible-stat deltas caused by housing events, especially MNY and SPR
eventFrequencyTelemetry.purpose: Determine whether the manual 'move home' repetition is a corpus-frequency issue, a single repeatable-event issue, or sampling noise.

perStat: probability of any ending within horizon conditional on band
probability of Material Commitment within horizon conditional on band
probability of faction COMMITTED transition within horizon conditional on band
lowStatRiskTelemetry.purpose: Measure whether low visible stats already correlate with danger before authoring a new Visible-Stat Pressure content layer. Do not infer causation from correlation.

perFaction: personal faction event count per contacted faction-run: exactly 1, exactly 2, 3+
mean/median years between personal faction events
share opting out/closing at first disposition
factionChainTelemetry.purpose: Quantify the human observation that faction chains are hard to perceive and safe exit is frequent. This is a narrative-legibility diagnostic; do not change FSM rules in this run.

endingAgePriority: 25-34 should become a major or largest bucket
65+ should fall materially from the current survivor-heavy shape
do not reject a profile solely because 18-24 remains below final target; new adverse pathways are expected to contribute later
selectionReviewGuardrails.ifNoArmLooksPlausible: Report that no profile is satisfactory. Do not interpolate, auto-tune, or edit canonical thresholds.

retentionPolicy.note: All omitted harnesses remain retained for H2B or future relevant regression work.
